name: M3_CMS007MI_LstPrtfSections
description: This tool can list XML Sections used in M3 printer files. Printer files are used do define documents in M3 output management.

inputParameters.name: PRTF
inputParameters.description: Printer file that the XML section belongs to.

inputParameters.name: RPLY
inputParameters.description: XML structure that the section is defined within.

outputParameters.name: PRTF
outputParameters.description: Printer file that the XML section belongs to.

outputParameters.name: RPLY
outputParameters.description: XML structure that the section is defined within.

outputParameters.name: RPBK
outputParameters.description: Identifier of the XML section

outputParameters.name: XMBS
outputParameters.description: Status of the section indicating whether it is active for XML, CSV, or other output formats.
outputParameters.enumConstants: Not Active (10),Active For XML (20),Active For CSV (30),Active For Flat file (40),Active (80)

outputParameters.name: ELNM
outputParameters.description: Element name that defines the XML tag used for the section.

outputParameters.name: STYE
outputParameters.description: Type of section, such as metadata, header, row, or total, which determines how it is treated in the XML output.

outputParameters.name: SNNO
outputParameters.description: Sequence number that controls the order in which this section is processed or printed within its level.

outputParameters.name: BLLE
outputParameters.description: Level in the XML structure that determines where this section is positioned and printed.

outputParameters.name: EMEL
outputParameters.description: Indicates whether elements with no content should still be included in the XML output for this section.

outputParameters.name: SATR
outputParameters.description: Option specifying which attribute values are automatically added to the XML section element in the output.
outputParameters.enumConstants: No Section Attribute (1),Section Label (2),Section Label And Section Type Name (3),Section Type Name (4)

outputParameters.name: GRBY
outputParameters.description: Element whose value is used to group this section together with consecutive sections in the XML output.

outputParameters.name: FGBY
outputParameters.description: Element whose value is used for an additional subgrouping within an already grouped section.

outputParameters.name: TBLN
outputParameters.description: Table name used to match CSV data from this section to the corresponding table in the Excel template.

outputParameters.name: SHTN
outputParameters.description: Sheet name used to match CSV data from this section to the correct sheet in the Excel template.

outputParameters.name: LAIC
outputParameters.description: Option defining which label, if any, is included for this section in the XML file.
outputParameters.enumConstants: No Label (1),Standard Message Id (2),Overriding Msg (3),Overriding Name (4),Field Value (5)

outputParameters.name: OVM7
outputParameters.description: Overriding message ID used instead of the standard message when resolving the label for this section.

outputParameters.name: MSGF
outputParameters.description: Message file that contains the standard or overriding message IDs used as labels for this section.

outputParameters.name: OVNM
outputParameters.description: Overriding name text used as the label for this section when no overriding message ID is specified.

outputParameters.name: OBLA
outputParameters.description: Field whose value controls when this section is disabled or hidden in the output.

outputParameters.name: FSMG
outputParameters.description: Indicates whether the standard message is used as a fallback label when no translation is defined.

outputParameters.name: EXSE
outputParameters.description: Indicates whether an Xtend M3 script is executed before the contents of this section are output.

outputParameters.name: GRBS
outputParameters.description: Identifier of the grouping section to which this section belongs.

outputParameters.name: RPBA
outputParameters.description: Base XML section that acts as the parent section for this section.
